The series then becomes a telescoping sum $\sum_{n=1}^\infty \left( \frac{1}{F_n} - \frac{1}{F_{n+2}} \right)$, which simplifies to $\frac{1}{F_1} + \frac{1}{F_2}$ as the terms involving $F_{N+1}$ and $F_{N+2}$ approach zero in the limit.

Given the initial values $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$, we have $F_2 = F_1 + F_0 = 1$, so the sum evaluates to $\frac{1}{1} + \frac{1}{1} = 2$.
